description: The main window may open https links in the system browser, read and write only the folders the person picks in the system dialog (local folder projects, #178), and sign in to Google through the system browser, getting only short-lived access tokens (#177), check for and install signed app updates (#179), run WebRTC data channels in the shell where the webview has none (#176), and compile with a local TeX Live when the person turned that on (#264). Add a permission only with the feature that needs it (docs/desktop.md, Security).
